_help: toy_harvest.py settings. Edit, then check without the robot: ~/miniconda3/envs/g1_dex3_sim2real/bin/python sim2real/harvest_moves.py (the poses, the body clearance along the scripted moves, where the hand drops into the basket). Joint vectors are the right arm in RIGHT_ARM_JOINTS order: shoulder pitch, roll, yaw, elbow, wrist roll, pitch, yaw [rad].
_home_q: HOME: the arm tucked down by the hip, nothing in front of the chest (the hand 0.30 m from the waist axis; the old home 0.46 m). The waist only turns with the arm here; the camera looks from here. Body cover clearance +4.8 cm at every waist yaw of the scan.
_ready_q: READY: where the arm-pose policy starts and ends (null = reach_io's HOME_Q, the old home the policy ran from on the robot). HOME <-> READY is a scripted joint move through home_ready_via. In sim (scripts/eval_harvest_home.py) the policy started from HOME itself brushed the hip.
_home_ready_via: the arm out to the side on the way between HOME and READY (the straight joint line cuts the thigh's cover by 5.6 cm; through here +3.7 cm worst over the scan's waist yaws)

basket._help: WHERE THE BASKET IS: from_shoulder_m = the basket point minus the right shoulder, with the waist at 0, in the torso frame [x forward, y left, z up] -- the default is the grasp pocket of the right arm stretched straight out to the right, the palm at shoulder height. It is fixed to the ground. DEPOSIT: the waist turns into waist_range_deg (only as far as needed: the nearest yaw in the range; the arm tucked at HOME), HOME -> READY, then ONE arm-pose policy goal: the drop point (the basket point pulled toward the torso axis until it is max_reach_m from the shoulder) with the palm facing the GROUND and the fingers along the arm (the horizontal shoulder -> drop line); the hand opens (a warning if the pocket ended further than accept_m), back to READY -> HOME, the waist back. Sim (scripts/eval_basket_waist.py --palm down --fingers arm --no_staging): waist -30 / -15 / 0 deg 3/3 each in 3.6-4.3 s, 1.4 cm, no body overlap or near miss (the palm-horizontal drop through a staging point took 9.6-11 s). Apples within exclude_radius_m (horizontally) of the basket point are never harvested (an apple in the basket is still an apple to the camera).

moves._help: peak joint speed of the scripted moves (HOME <-> READY)

detach._help: DETACH, after the grasp and before the policy takes the apple back: the hand pulled straight back along the approach by pull_m at pull_speed_m_s, stiffer (kp / kd) than the policy's 100 / 10 so that a snapping stem moves the arm less. The pull waits (does not advance) while kp x lead > tau_cap_nm on a shoulder / elbow joint: the stem holds and the stored spring stays small. A joint faster than snap_dq = the stem broke: the target is put where the arm IS (the spring let go). Still holding after stall_s of waiting: the tension is let off, the hand opens (a missed try). Up to speed_stop rad/s is no safety stop here (the snap is expected; robot 2026-10-19: 1.4 rad/s at kp 100 stopped the run).

view._help: An apple is harvested only when it is whole in the head camera's picture left-right (its box at least margin_px from the left / right edges) and its centre at least edge_frac of the half-width from those edges; else the waist turns to centre it first. Above / below: no rule. image_w / fx / cx: until /unitree/color/camera_info is heard (then that); without a box (none in the message) the apple's sphere is projected with them. labels: only the detector's boxes of these classes are harvested (user 2026-10-19: red apples only; the green_apple class also fired on a person's shoes and on the cart).

waist._help: the waist counts as still (LOCKED) when its measured yaw stayed within lock_range_deg over lock_window_s, within lock_tol_deg of the target; else after lock_timeout_s the run goes on (with a warning). Robot 2026-10-19: the old speed test never passed (5 s lost at every waist move).

reach._help: REACHABILITY without IK: sim2real/reach_map.py samples the arm's joint space inside the robot's limits once (offline) and stores, per 2 cm cell around the right shoulder, the palm headings that reach it (the apple's approach rule, or turned up to +-60 deg). Per apple the waist yaw (within the scan range) and the palm turn are chosen by table look-ups: the cost palm turn / palm_turn_cost_deg + waist turn / waist_turn_cost_deg is the smallest; an apple reachable at no yaw of the range is skipped. Rebuild after a change of the robot's joint limits: python3 sim2real/reach_map.py --build.
